The Puritech Siliphos polyphosphate media 10?kg is a specialised water treatment product designed to protect plumbing systems and appliances from scale formation and corrosion. This product is ideal for residential, commercial, and industrial settings where scale prevention and corrosion control are important for maintaining efficient water flow and prolonging the service life of equipment.

What Is Siliphos Polyphosphate Media?

Siliphos polyphosphate media consists of transparent, food-grade polyphosphate balls that dissolve slowly into flowing water. As they dissolve, they release polyphosphate and silicate, which help keep hardness minerals and corrosive elements in solution, rather than allowing them to deposit on pipes, boilers, heaters, and other water system components.

This action helps reduce the build-up of scale and stops the corrosion that can cause brown or rusty water, pinhole leaks, or reduced water pressure.

Key Benefits

  • Prevents Scale Build-Up: Reduces deposits from calcium and magnesium minerals.
  • Protects Against Corrosion: Helps form a protective layer on internal metal surfaces, reducing rust and oxidation.
  • Improves System Efficiency: Helps maintain water flow and prevents energy loss due to scale on heating elements.
  • Low Maintenance: Requires a simple refill every few months, with no electricity or complex installation.
  • Safe for Drinking Water: Colourless, tasteless, and safe when used at recommended concentrations (2-3?ppm).

How It Works

When installed in a filter housing or dispenser chamber where water flows through the media, Siliphos polyphosphate slowly dissolves into the water. The released polyphosphates then bind to hardness minerals like calcium and magnesium, keeping them dissolved and helping prevent scale locks on pipe walls and heating elements. At the same time, the silicate component helps form a protective coating on metal surfaces to reduce corrosion.

Importantly, this media does not remove hardness minerals from the water; instead, it prevents them from forming solid deposits, which is different from a softener system.

Where to Use Siliphos Polyphosphate Media

This 10?kg pack is suitable for:

  • Residential plumbing systems where scaling causes blocked valves or reduced flow.
  • Boilers and water heaters to reduce scaling on heating elements.

Installation & Maintenance

  1. Install it in a suitable filter housing or cartridge where water flows through the media.
  2. Monitor water quality and system performance periodically to ensure the media is dissolving properly.
  3. Replace or refill the media every 3-6 months or when visual depletion is noticeable.

Installation is simple, and no electricity or special tools are required, making it a very low-maintenance solution for scale and corrosion management.

Comparison with Traditional Scale Prevention

Unlike water softeners, which exchange hardness minerals for sodium or potassium, Siliphos polyphosphate media prevents scale without removing minerals, allowing harmless coexistence of these elements in water while controlling their tendency to form deposits.

Conclusion

The Puritech Siliphos polyphosphate media 10?kg offers an economical and effective way to protect your water system against scale and corrosion.
